title: cyclobalanopsis marginata
intro: Cyclobalanopsis marginata, commonly known as the Japanese oak, is a deciduous tree species native to East Asia. The health benefits of Cyclobalanopsis marginata include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant, which may help to protect against cell damage and promote overall well-being. Bioactive constituents present in Cyclobalanopsis marginata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are thought to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
